# FAIL

## Requirement Summary

"DX Coil Height must be calculated as the sum of all Cooling Circuit Heights (in inches), recalculated immediately after any height edit, with an empty circuit list resulting in 0 inches. Inputs are already validated and no other behavior is required."

## Reviewer Findings

- F1 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "Unclear which actions are considered a \"height edit\" that should trigger recalculation." | "Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on the specific actions that constitute a height edit (e.g., editing a circuit height, adding or removing circuits)."
- F2 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "Unclear whether recalculation should also occur when circuits are added to or removed from the list, or only when an existing circuit's height value changes." | "Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on whether recalculation is required on circuit addition/removal or only on height value changes."

## Open Ambiguities

- /ambiguities/0 | "What specific actions are considered a \"height edit\" that should trigger recalculation (e.g., editing a circuit height, adding or removing circuits)?"
- /ambiguities/1 | "Should recalculation also occur when circuits are added to or removed from the list, or only when an existing circuit's height value changes?"

## Final Disposition

FAIL

- OPEN_FINDINGS
- OPEN_AMBIGUITIES
